verdict.rationale: LiveKit's telephony docs refer to configurable trunks, including region restriction, and dispatch rules, which implies you can bring your own trunk. Connectors bridge to external platforms such as Twilio and WhatsApp, and the Phone Numbers option is framed as an alternative to setting up trunks, so you are not tied to one carrier. However, the evidence never explicitly describes SIP protocol interoperability or lists compatible trunking providers. missing for 10: explicit SIP trunk interop documentation, named list of supported or compatible SIP providers, hands-on corroboration of connecting an existing carrier trunk.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier

citations.quote: Trunks can be region restricted to meet local telephony regulations.
Connectors bridge LiveKit rooms with external voice platforms such as WhatsApp Business and Twilio.
LiveKit Phone Numbers lets you provision phone numbers and connect PSTN calls directly into LiveKit rooms without setting up trunks.
